title: Luscious Date Ouzi
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dessert with sweet dates and crispy phyllo. Perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Thaw phyllo dough according to package instructions.
In a bowl, mix together dates, cinnamon, cardamom, and honey.
Layer phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Spread date mixture on top of phyllo layer.
Top with another layer of phyllo dough, brushing with melted butter.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until phyllo is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool.
Sprinkle with chopped almonds, if using.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
